grading_standard: Correct = every actually asked material fact resolved correctly with summary support, no material contradiction. Partial = asked omission/unresolved part without contradiction. Incorrect = material contradiction. Context is not an extra requirement. Assess every substantive same-entry field; labels and formatting alone do not set grade.
